sources.title: Pinned signed Git annotated release tag for runc v1.1.12 and CVE-2024-21626
sources.date_evidence: Exact Git tag object OID 20381324e21b5b232fea74d448b5975d85d34d25 points at commit 51d5e94601ceffbbd85688df1c928ecccbfa4685 (official public GitHub tag API). Official GitHub v1.1.12 release record currently reports public published_at=2024-01-31T20:06:08Z; the earlier tagger timestamp is not proof of public availability. Original Git object bytes can be acquired and independently hashed with scripts/acquire_runc_git_tag.py but first-public-availability of those exact bytes, trusted PGP key and archival/reuse decision remain pending.
sources.selection_rationale: Immutable content-addressed primary publisher advisory tag containing original CVE disclosure text, distinct from mutable release HTML; same publisher and not an independent extra early source

sources.title: Original January 31 GHSA-xr7r-f8xq-vfvv JSON at independently archived public commit
sources.publisher: GitHub Advisory Database / opencontainers runc maintainers
sources.date_evidence: Original 13,105-byte JSON is bound by Git object identities to commit 02a8b9a4f9d305f0e028ef58f0dcf28f55bf10ae. GH Archive public PushEvent 35293494004 names that exact commit at 2024-01-31T22:46:10Z. Offline replay verifies the full hourly archive, exact event line and commit/tree/blob chain. Proposed public-by time requires investigator acceptance of the archive and event timestamp, not first-ever publication or a cryptographic timestamp. See docs/research/P1A_ORIGINAL_ADVISORY_WITNESS.md and docs/research/P1A_ORIGINAL_ADVISORY_RECEIPT.md.
sources.selection_rationale: Alternative pinned early maintainer source, not a third early report or independent corroboration. Same-commit README/LICENSE provide CC-BY-4.0 evidence for source-specific review. Measured bytes are recorded separately; study approval fields stay unset.
